name: Rallly
title: rallly.co
shortDescription: Rallly is a tool designed to coordinate group meetings efficiently, eliminating the need for back-and-forth emails. It's ideal for professionals who manage frequent team meetings or event planners coordinating with large groups. Users can quickly set up polls to determine the best meeting times, making it a go-to solution for simplifying scheduling tasks. Rallly's user-friendly interface allows for quick setup and minimal interaction, making it perfect for both small teams and large organizations.
cons: Dependent on user donations for funding
